properties.name: 5059x
properties.notes: Former school site that has been declared surplus following closure in 2011. The school buildings have already been demolished and the site cleared in readiness for redevelopment, enabled by an earlier approval (13/01267/DEMGDO). Mainly brownfield but wider site includes former playing fields. An application for development of 66 homes is now pending consideration (16/03954/FUL). Brownfield land (0.61ha) represents around 25% of the site area - a yield of around 16 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 5059) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 2.39ha. If the current application is permitted, the deliverability of development will be reappraised. Identified as an allocation in the Reg.19 Local Plan (submitted May 2019).
properties.site-address: Moorside First School, Woodhorn Road, Newbiggin-by-the-Sea (brownfield parcel)
